item.title: Low‐Pressure All‐Solid‐State Lithium–Sulfur Batteries: Challenges and Design Principles
item.description:

Interdisciplinary Materials | 💭 Perspective | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This perspective reframes pressure as a compensatory crutch, not a solution, and identifies chemo-mechanical mismatch as the root cause of low-pressure ASSLSB degradation. It proposes design principles—reaction accessibility, adaptive ion-conducting phases, and stable interfaces—shifting focus from accommodating pressure to eliminating pressure dependence, a critical step for practical high-energy solid-state batteries.
